notes.title: Update v1.0.18
notes.content:
This update contains a handful of updates and fixes. There has also been some groundwork lain for a possible mobile build of the game. 

[list]
[*] Fixed game crash when switching warp level in non-Steam versions of the game
[*] Fixed final cutscene sequence restarting when accessing the menu from end game score screen
[*] Fixed soft-lock when QBob was abducted at the same time as a grenade
[/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed game crash when switching warp level in non-Steam versions of the game
- Fixed final cutscene sequence restarting when accessing the menu from end game score screen
- Fixed soft-lock when QBob was abducted at the same time as a grenade

notes.title: v1.0.17
notes.content:
A few minor cosmetic changes and a new talking head added!

[b]Added[/b]

- The Soup Nazi will scold you if you die in the explosion!

[b]Changed[/b]

- Prevent Roswell from spawning if self-destruct is less than 7
- Roswell no longer "dies" when self-destruct timer starts. He will continue jumping until 4 is reached then do a standard exit.
- End of level explosion now triggers QBob fire death if he's caught in the blast

[b]Fixed[/b]

- Fixed end of level text from appearing on level restart if starting from post-explosion game over
- Fixed texture load stutter if starting on Level 4

tags.feature: - The Soup Nazi will scold you if you die in the explosion!

tags.balance_change: - Prevent Roswell from spawning if self-destruct is less than 7
- Roswell no longer "dies" when self-destruct timer starts. He will continue jumping until 4 is reached then do a standard exit.
- End of level explosion now triggers QBob fire death if he's caught in the blast

tags.bug: - Fixed end of level text from appearing on level restart if starting from post-explosion game over
- Fixed texture load stutter if starting on Level 4

notes.title: Update v1.0.16
notes.content: [p]Thanks to everyone who has played [i]QBob: Remastered[/i] during its first week on Steam![/p][p]We've had a couple feature requests which have been included in this update. The most requested one we've added was the ability to jump right back into the game without having to navigate back to the main menu.[/p][p]If you have any more suggestions, [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3781720/discussions/"]start a discussion[/url] and we'll take a look![/p][p][b]Here are the changes in this update:[/b][/p][p][b]Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players can now restart the game immediately from the game over menu without having to return to the splash screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added a help message if player jumps off asteroid telling them that in EASY mode, QBob can't fall off[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Level warps no longer limited to post intermission levels. Start the game from any level that you've reached![/p][/*][*][p]Demo version now also allows players to start game at any demo level they have reached[/p][/*][*][p]Start button remembers starting level of previous game[/p][/*][*][p]Chaser idle times for EASY and NORMAL lowered just a tad[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixed[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hubcap no longer stalls after attacking the leftmost cube[/p][/*][*][p]ESC now checks for transition layer on High Score screen[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Players can now restart the game immediately from the game over menu without having to return to the splash screen
Added a help message if player jumps off asteroid telling them that in EASY mode, QBob can't fall off

tags.balance_change: Level warps no longer limited to post intermission levels. Start the game from any level that you've reached!
Demo version now also allows players to start game at any demo level they have reached
Start button remembers starting level of previous game
Chaser idle times for EASY and NORMAL lowered just a tad

tags.bug: Hubcap no longer stalls after attacking the leftmost cube
ESC now checks for transition layer on High Score screen

notes.title: Update v1.0.10
notes.content: [p]After much work we finally have [i]QBob: Remastered[/i] running on MacOS and Ubuntu Linux! In theory, Ubuntu support also means that the game should run natively on Steam Deck! Take that with a grain of salt though: we don't own a Steam Deck and are unable to test it out for ourselves.[/p][p]Some other tweaks in this latest update:[/p][list][*][p]Some more control fixes, including an annoying Paintgun glitch[/p][/*][*][p]Added some more Paintgun sounds[/p][/*][*][p]QBob grunts if he's caught in the explosion (grunting fans rejoice!)[/p][/*][*][p]We've published an online manual and it's fantastic![/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://projectsoffun.github.io/QBob-Manual/QBob-Remastered-Manual.pdf" style="button"]QBob: Remastered Manual (PDF)[/url][/p]

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content: [p]Steam has approved QBob: Remastered for release! We have set the official release date and time to [b][u]Thursday, July 24th at noon CST![/u][/b] [/p][p]Here are some of the updates included in this latest patch:[/p][list][*][p]We've added checks that will allow us to create a demo version of QBob: Remastered. More on this soon![/p][/*][*][p]Better gamepad support (as per Valves's review suggestions):[/p][list][*][p]In theory, XBox "Home" button should trigger Steam overlay on some XBox controllers[/p][/*][*][p]Game can now detect if you are actively using a gamepad. If gamepad is in use, the in-game help prompts and dialogues will reflect gamepad controls[/p][/*][*][p]High score name entry with left stick added[/p][/*][*][p]MoonRock logo is skippable with any button press[/p][/*][*][p]If gamepad connection is lost whilst actively playing game, game will pause[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Triggering Steam Overlay will pause an in-progress game [/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: We've added checks that will allow us to create a demo version of QBob: Remastered. More on this soon!
In theory, XBox "Home" button should trigger Steam overlay on some XBox controllers
Game can now detect if you are actively using a gamepad. If gamepad is in use, the in-game help prompts and dialogues will reflect gamepad controls
High score name entry with left stick added
MoonRock logo is skippable with any button press
If gamepad connection is lost whilst actively playing game, game will pause
Triggering Steam Overlay will pause an in-progress game

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content: [p]No sooner did we send version 1.0 out that we discovered a game crashing bug in the level set-up code.[/p][p]Turns out that deprecated code that I removed did a bit more that I thought it did. Never fear though, I have replaced the suspect code and squashed this bug![/p]

tags.bug: Turns out that deprecated code that I removed did a bit more that I thought it did. Never fear though, I have replaced the suspect code and squashed this bug!

notes.title: Pre-Release Patch v0.102.0
notes.content: [p]We're getting very close to the final build of [i]QBob: Remastered[/i]![/p][p]Here are some of the updates that are included in this patch:[/p][list][*][p]More refined meteor collisions allowing for QBob to escape death in some rare edge cases[/p][/*][*][p]XBob will no longer spawn on a telepad if QBob is in the process of teleporting IN to that same pad[/p][/*][*][p]Level 17 easy mode is now even easier![/p][/*][*][p]Sound levels tweaked on level 20 to make boss louder[/p][/*][*][p]Grenade painting bug fixed when destroying a meteor or Roswell[/p][/*][*][p]A few other random balancing changes regarding power-up timing[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: - More refined meteor collisions allowing for QBob to escape death in some rare edge cases

tags.bug: - XBob will no longer spawn on a telepad if QBob is in the process of teleporting IN to that same pad

tags.balance_change: - Level 17 easy mode is now even easier!
- Sound levels tweaked on level 20 to make boss louder

tags.bug: - Grenade painting bug fixed when destroying a meteor or Roswell

tags.balance_change: - A few other random balancing changes regarding power-up timing
